requirements.text: Patients should be able to view available appointment time slots
Patients should be able to book appointments directly
Patients should be able to cancel or reschedule their appointments without contacting the clinic
The portal should have a simple and straightforward navigation system
There should be minimal complicated steps for managing appointments
A short training session for staff should be provided to help them get familiar with the portal
Patients should have access to a list of their current medications
Patients should be able to request refills by selecting from their current medications list
There should be a secure login or verification process to access patient information
The system should protect the confidentiality and privacy of patient data
